svg.title: gzip compression: speed against ratio
svg.desc: Each tool at its fast, balanced, and dense levels; up and to the right is better.
svg.text: gzip compression: speed against compression ratio
Each line is one tool at its fast, balanced, and dense levels (numbers are levels on the tool's own scale). Up and to the right is better.
Ratio is plaintext bytes / compressed bytes. MB/s is plaintext MB (10^6 bytes) per second of median wall time. Each panel has its own scales.
